content: Awařen ineggura n Dawud
Ina d awařen ineggura n Dawud.
Dawud, mmis n Yassa issawař, bu-teɣruḍt i ittwassɛuǧan issawař, amedhun n AREBBI n Yaɛqub, amedyaz iɛizzen n Israil.
Arruḥ n SIDI issiweř zzayi u awař nnes x iřes inu.
AREBBI n Israil inna, aqa Taṣḍart n Israil tessiweř akidi:
“Ijj n řḥakem jar iwdan, ijj n umsegged, ijj n řḥakem nni itteggʷeden AREBBI,
wenni iggin am tfawt ɣar tuffut xmi dd-tneqqar tfuct, ɣar ict n tuffut břa iseynuten iɛbubbzen, xmi, s tissiqt n tfawt awarni i wenẓar, aqa issfuffuy aɣemmuy aziza zi temmurt.”
“Ma war teǧi taddart inu ɣar Arebbi amenni? Aqa igga ayi ijj n Řɛahd i řebda, msettef di marra u ittwaḥḍa. Qaɛ asenjem inu d marra min issnekkaran řefraḥet, ma Netta war issɣemmi aya?
Maca inni war isekkwin ad ttwammenḍaren am ict n tseṭṭa ak-d isennanen, marra nitni, maɣar war izemmar ad ttwaṭṭfen s ufus.
Aryaz i ixsen ad tent iḥada, ad iḥezzem ixef nnes s wuzzař d ukeccuḍ n lansa u nitni ad ttwasscemḍen s tmessi deg wemcan nsen.”
Ayt n bu-teɣruḍt n Dawud
Ina d ismawen n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt i iǧan ɣar Dawud: Yucayb Bacabbat, mmis n Atahkamuni, azeǧif n ineɣrafen. Lansa nnes tuɣa d řehzuṭ nnes, issnuqqeb temn-mya n yeryazen deg ijj n umenɣi.

Awarni as yusa-dd Aliɛazar, mmis n Dudu, mmis n Axuxi. Netta tuɣa d ijjen zi třata n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt nni iǧan ak-d Dawud, řami nitni stehzan zeg Ifilisṭiniyyen nni tuɣa din munen i umenɣi, am geɛɛden iryazen n Israil ɣarsen i umenɣi.
Netta ikkar, iwta deg Ifilisṭiniyyen ař yuḥeř ufus nnes. Iřṣeq ufus nnes di ssif. SIDI yiwiḍ ijj n usenjem d ameqqran deg wass nni uca iryazen n řgens ɛeqben awarni as, maca mɣir ḥima ad keccḍen.
Awarni as yusa-dd Camma, mmis n Aji, Aharari. Řami nnjarwen Ifilisṭiniyyen ɣar Laxi, tuɣa dinni ijj n iyyar iccuren s řeɛdes. Řgens tuɣa yarweř zzat i wudem n Ifilisṭiniyyen.
Netta ibedd di řwest n ureqqiɛ n iyyar nni, ifekk i-t-i-dd uca iɣřeb x Ifilisṭiniyyen. Ammu yarra as SIDI ijj n weɣřab d ameqqran.
Třata zi třatin n izeǧifen hwan, usin-dd ɣar Dawud di řweqt n tmeyra, deg ifri n Abdullam. Tuɣa din ict n terbiɛt n Ifilisṭiniyyen tewta iqiḍan nsen di teɣzurt n Irafawiyyen.
Dawud tuɣa-t di lqelɛa u tuɣa din ict n teřbiḥt n řɛeskar n Ifilisṭiniyyen di Bayt-Laḥm.
Uca Dawud iřqef i-t ufadi, inna: “Wi d ayi i dd ɣa yawyen aman zi tařa n Bayt-Laḥm i iǧan ɣar tewwart n tendint?”

Xenni cuqen třata n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt nni řmargeḥ n řɛeskar n Ifilisṭiniyyen, uymen-dd aman zi tařa n Bayt-Laḥm, i iǧan ɣar tewwart n tendint. Ksin ten akidsen u iwḍen ɣar Dawud, maca netta yugi ad ten isu uca izeǧeɛ i-ten zzat i SIDI.

Netta inna: “Aya iggʷej xafi, a SIDI, aqa necc ad ggeɣ man aya. Ma ad sweɣ idammen n yeryazen, inni din iruḥen am sebbřen tudart nsen?” U netta war ixs ad ten isu. D man aya i t iggin třata n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt nni.
Abicay, mmis n Yuwab, mmis n Ṣaruya, tuɣa d azeǧif n třata nni. Netta iḥenneḍ lansa nnes x teřt-mya, issnuqqeb i-ten. Netta ɣares ijj n isem ittwacenneɛ jar třata nni.
Ma war iǧi netta d wenni ittwacennɛen aṭṭas zi třata-ya? S uya tuɣa netta d řqebṭan nsen. Maca netta war yiwiḍ uřa ɣar třata n imezwura.

Xenni Banaya, mmis n Yahuyadaɛ, mmis n ijj weryaz imeḥḍen, timegga nnes mɣarent, netta zi Qabḍiyil. Netta iɣřeb x tnayen n iyraden ijehden. Ɛawed tuɣa netta ihwa ict n twařa, iɣřeb x ijj n weyrad di řwesṭ n ijj n wanu deg ijj n wass umi iwta wedfeř.
Netta iɣřeb uřa x yijj n weryaz d Amiṣri, ijj n weryaz isseggʷaden. Amiṣri tuɣa ɣares ict n lansa deg ufus nnes. Ihwa ɣares s yijj n weɛmud, ikkes lansa zeg ufus n Umiṣri u inɣa i-t s lansa nnes.
D man aya i igga Banaya, mmis n Yahuyadaɛ. S uya ɣares isem icneɛ jar třata n ayt n bu-teɣruḍt.
Netta tuɣa d wenni ittwacennɛen aṭṭas zi třatin, maca war yiweḍ ař třata imezwura. Dawud igga i-t jar imtiqqan nnes.
Tuɣa Ɛasa’il, umas n Yuwab, jar třatin; Ilḥanan, mmis n Dudu, zi Bayt-Laḥm;
Camɛa, Aḥarudi; Iliqa, Aḥarudi;
Halaṣ, Afalṭi; Ɛira, mmis n Ɛiqqic, Atiqquɛi;
Abiɛazar, Aɛanatuti; Mabunnay, Aḥucayi;
Ṣalmun, Axuxi; Mahray, Anaṭufati;
Xalab, mmis n Baɛna, Anaṭufati; Ittay, mmis n Ribay, zi Jibɛa zeg ayt n Binyamin;
Banaya, zi Firɛatun; Hidday, zi teɣzurin n Jaɛac;
Abu-Ɛalbun, Aɛarabati; Ɛazmawet, Abarḥumi;
Ilyaḥba, Acaɛlubuni; zeg iḥenjiren n Yacan, mɣir Yunatan;
Camma, Aharari; Axiyam, mmis Carar, Arari;
Ilifalaṭ, mmis n Aḥasbay, mmis n Umaɛki; Iɛam, mmis n Axiṭufil, Ajiluni;
Ḥaṣray, Akarmali; Faɛray, Alarbi;
Yijɛal, mmis n Natan, zi Ṣuba; Bani, Ajadi;
Ṣalaq, Aɛammuni; Naḥray, Abiɛruti, aḥemmař n řesnaḥ n Yuwab, mmis n Ṣaruya;
Ɛira, Ayitri; Jarib, Ayitri;
Uriya, Aḥitti. Marra jmiɛ sebɛa u-třatin n yeryazen.
